profile.name: Minitel 终端
profile.description: Minitel 是一种带显示屏和键盘的法国语音视频文本终端，可通过 TTL 串口与计算机通信。它适用于显示文本与简单图形、接收键盘输入、切换工作模式以及进行复古终端交互、通信协议演示和人机界面实验。
profile.description_en: A Minitel is a French videotex terminal with a screen and keyboard that communicates with a computer over a TTL serial link. It is used to display text and simple graphics, accept keyboard input, switch operating modes, and support retro terminal interaction, communication protocol demonstrations, and human-machine interface experiments.
